description: This file defines the AndroidPsiAugmentProvider class, which extends PsiAugmentProvider to provide code augmentation for Android resource classes and manifest classes within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment. It handles dynamic generation of resource inner classes and fields based on project resources.

classes.name: AndroidPsiAugmentProvider
classes.description: A class extending PsiAugmentProvider to dynamically augment Android resource and manifest classes in the IDE.

methods.name: getAugments
methods.description: Provides additional Psi elements (classes or fields) for Android resource and manifest classes based on project resources.

methods.name: getOwnInnerClasses
methods.description: Returns a set of inner class names defined within a given PsiExtensibleClass.

methods.name: getOwnFields
methods.description: Returns a set of field names defined within a given PsiExtensibleClass.
